calls.statement:
WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, member_key, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS rows_any_version,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS distinct_members,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND vn = 1) AS first_version_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND valid_from = DATE '2026-09-25') AS rows_valid_from_day,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-24') AS d24,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-26') AS d26,
  MAX(join_date) AS max_join, MAX(valid_from) AS max_valid_from
FROM fv

SELECT home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS dm, MIN(valid_from) AS vf, MAX(valid_to) AS vt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS cur
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
